fieldValues.title: Semantic maturity tier
fieldValues.description: How far a captured instance has been formalised, expressed as a tier and not as a yes-or-no. Tier 0 is a Note: named text sections, no type binding, no field semantics. Tier 2 is a Record: fields bound to a Type, fully semantic. The point of the tier model is that half-formed material is first-class — meaning may be captured before its shape is known and formalised later, instead of being lost because no template fitted it yet. An implementation may support only Tier 2.
fieldValues.notes: The gap at Tier 1 is deliberate. `TypedRecord` was removed as an unexercised construct and the surviving tiers were not renumbered, so existing references stay valid.
